package rulefixtures

import (
	"sync"
)

// scenario for sync_mutex_for_readonly_config: `mu.RLock(); v := config.X; mu.RUnlock()` for read-mostly config that changes rarely
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.

type AppConfig struct {
	Port    int
	Env     string
	Version string
}

type ConfigManager struct {
	mu     sync.RWMutex
	config AppConfig
}

func (cm *ConfigManager) GetPort() int {
	cm.mu.RLock()
	port := cm.config.Port
	cm.mu.RUnlock()
	return port
}

func (cm *ConfigManager) GetEnv() string {
	cm.mu.RLock()
	env := cm.config.Env
	cm.mu.RUnlock()
	return env
}
